title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-03-02
source: Ampex MM-1000 16 Track Master Two Inch Wide Tape-Multi Track Mix-down  By Dan Healy @ 44.1KHz); DAT x ONE by Dick Latvala- DAT x TWO; Editing (Adobe Audition CC)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name)by Jim Wise; This is a 100% Flat transfer from the DAT no signal processing what-so-ever

ai_review.summary: Near‑perfect multitrack soundboard capture of a classic Fillmore West set highlighted by a soaring Dark Star, The Eleven and an epic Other One suite.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear instrument separation and clean multi‑track mix, making the interplay between Jerry Garcia and Tom Constanten shine. Musically the show delivers several of the era’s peak moments – a monster Dark Star, a revving The Eleven, and an expansive Other One/Alligator suite – even if one reviewer notes a few speed‑fluctuation glitches and that the night isn’t the absolute pinnacle of the run.

ai_rating.rationale: Six out of seven reviews are 5‑star, highlighting both outstanding performance and superb recording; the lone 3‑star review adds technical caveats but does not overturn the overall high praise.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multi‑track (16‑track) mixdown with excellent instrument separation and clarity; some listeners report occasional speed/pitch waver artifacts but overall the transfer is clean and dynamic.

standout_songs: That's It For The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Final show of the famed Fillmore West run – starts with an early Dark Star featuring Constanten, moves through a classic Eleven and a loose Love Light vamp, then builds into a sprawling second set with the Other One suite and a marathon Alligator; overall energetic but slightly less tight than earlier nights.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar tone and improvisational push on Dark Star are repeatedly praised; his interplay with keyboards is highlighted as a show‑stopper.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s contributions are noted for adding fresh sounds, especially on the opening Dark Star and throughout the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum work receives commendation for its tightness and the post‑drum jam sections that drive parts of Alligator and Other One.
